# Ulysses LARS Charger

A 3 kW magnetic-resonant wireless charger that moves power from a surface
vessel's dock to a 48 V pack in an underwater vehicle, across a gap no
connector ever crosses.

Built with the [MakeHardware](https://github.com/Harwasch/MakeHardware) workflow.
This is **revision 2**; revision 1 is documented in
[`docs/design/v1-baseline.md`](docs/design/v1-baseline.md) and its source
material is preserved under `docs/reference/source/`.

## Where things stand

The four agreement stages — vision, plan, requirements, architecture — are
done. No design artefact exists yet, so `req-trace --gate` correctly reports
0% verified.

**There is no laboratory access.** Every number in this repository is an
analysis or simulation result, and the documents say so where it matters. Bench
verification is held as chunk `T2`, blocked, rather than deleted.

## Reproducing the analysis

Every load-bearing number comes from a script, not a paragraph:

```bash
/opt/hw-py/bin/python sim/link-budget/link_budget.py     # resonant link matching, k*Q, loss budget
/opt/hw-py/bin/python sim/link-budget/comms_budget.py    # in-band data rate against tank bandwidth
/opt/hw-py/bin/python sim/link-budget/charge_policy.py   # C-rate policy and what it implies about the pack
cd sim/coil
/opt/hw-py/bin/python coil_model.py       # inductance, two methods, cross-checked
/opt/hw-py/bin/python coil_coupling.py    # coupling across the misalignment envelope
/opt/hw-py/bin/python coil_resistance.py  # AC resistance and quality factor
```

## The gates

```bash
hw-doctor                 # what the toolchain can actually do right now
/hw-status                # plan progress, what is ready to start, requirements coverage
plan-render --check       # cycles, dangling deps, done-on-unfinished
block-diagram --check     # architecture gate; exit 1 on an over-budget rail
req-trace --gate          # traceability gate; exit 1 while gaps remain
```

`req-trace --gate` exits 1 today and should. Do not make it pass by marking a
requirement `Verified` without evidence at the corners.

## Environment

This repo needs a Claude Code cloud environment built from
[MakeHardware's `env/`](https://github.com/Harwasch/MakeHardware/tree/HEAD/env) —
network access **Full**, the environment variables file, and the setup script.
Run `hw-doctor` first if anything behaves unexpectedly; the friction log records
two setup defects worth fixing before the next session.
